confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Mendoza prices. The price sources were secondary aggregators (Numbeo-derived guides, expat and travel guides) and disagreed widely, because Argentine peso inflation and the exchange rate make USD conversions volatile. I picked bounded mid-values. Food anchors: inexpensive meal about $8-9 (one guide gives about $8.65), mid-range meal for two about $30-35, coffee about $3-4, beer about $3.50 (one source gives a $1.49-7.00 range). Cocktail and wine by the glass are less certain. Cocktail is set at about 2x beer, near the lower end of the $7-15 guide range. Wine by the glass is set at about 1.3x beer, since Mendoza wine is cheap locally. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from booking pages or current listings, and are the least certain. The RBA figure is the latest I could confirm, and some cached RBA pages in the results were stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Mendoza-specific aggregator figures, cross-checked against the general price level of Argentine tourist cities (for example Salta and Córdoba), which are cheaper than Buenos Aires but pricier than the rest of the region for wine-tourism services.
